title: From an isolated 3D feature to a connected workflow.
intro: The delivered experience connects scene staging, character paths, camera movement, shot sequencing and export back to the canvas. Onboarding and examples make that workflow discoverable inside the desktop product.

blocks.label: CONTINUE THE CREATION
blocks.title: Export the whole sequence—or the shots you need.
body: Creators can preview the assembled film or select individual shot clips for export. The output returns to the canvas as video material for the next stage of creation.
That closes the loop: the rehearsal is both an editable plan and a concrete artifact the creator can use.

figure.alt: Delivered export panel with Full Video and Shot Clips options and four selectable shot previews
figure.caption: Delivered product · Shot clips can be selected individually.

items.title: A connected editing system.
body: The final workflow brings spatial layout, time, camera and output into one product experience.
items.label: DELIVERED

items.title: A path to first use.
body: Editable examples, guided practice and visible generation feedback accompany the core editor.
items.label: DELIVERED

items.title: A release-ready handoff.
body: The feature reached main and the release branch in November 2026, supported by testing tasks and launch preparation.
items.label: DELIVERY MILESTONE

body: The evidence at this stage is a delivered workflow and its implementation history. I would evaluate the next phase through first real-project completion, the success of repeated local edits, and the total time and cost of reaching an acceptable downstream video.
